_about: Per-sticker StickerVectorizer settings. 'presets' are named bundles of settings; 'stickers' maps a sticker id (the PNG name in sprites/painting layers/) to a preset name or to its own settings. Anything not listed uses the defaults in scripts/plotter/StickerVectorizer.gd.

soft._why: Painterly / photographic stickers with no hard edges: squint (blur the colours) to find the big colour masses, boost saturation so dull greens and reds separate from greys and tans, and don't merge shades.

rich._why: Busy line work with many colours: keep close shades apart (purple edging next to magenta, etc).
